status: Proposed inbox/outbox fabric and synthetic age exploration

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high-fidelity Board visual design study exploring a continuous fabric surface for process inboxes and outboxes. Use the attached Board overview ONLY as a reference for brand, warm paper #f3f2eb, deep teal ink #192f34, precise typography, restrained UI, and process locations. This is a new concept, not a repaint of its simple hills.
Output a landscape image about 1920x1200. Render the application screen straight-on, with the oblique 3D membrane confined to its canvas. Crisp legible short labels, professional software design, no laptop or photo of a monitor. No trees, roads, buildings, geography, wireframe sci-fi, neon, glassmorphism, spikes, jagged rocks, random terrain, clouds or black holes. Fabric means a continuous smooth mathematical membrane with fine contour/grid lines, NOT woven textile, draped blankets, rips or floating disconnected donuts. Every deformation must be anchored to a labeled process.
Shared Board chrome: narrow deep-teal rail on the left with Map, Processes, Resources, Journeys; flat header Board / demo · Realm1, search field, Browse | Map toggle. One configured realm only. Scope is a displayed page. Use Inbox and Outbox as the user-facing terms. Do not include writable actions or simulated traffic particles. Colors do not claim worker health or delivery success. A thin outlined double ring marks selection so age color does not double as selection.
Surface grammar: the INBOX creates a broad lifted shoulder ABOVE the neutral membrane. The OUTBOX creates a narrower concave well pressed DOWN into the center of that shoulder. The well's depth is measured FROM THE SHOULDER, not merely net height above the world plane. Both quantities must remain visible. Thus both high creates a crater on a raised mound; inbox-only creates a convex bulge; outbox-only creates a pit BELOW the neutral sheet; both zero is FLAT. Light and mesh deformation must make convex and concave regions unambiguous.
Synthetic eight-process scene, same arrangement as reference:01 upperleft inbox18 outbox0 oldest—;02 uppermiddle inbox12 outbox4 oldest2m;03 upperright inbox8 outbox8 oldest6m;04 center selected inbox36 outbox12 oldest18m;05 right inbox6 outbox2 oldest45s;06 lowerright inbox4 outbox6 oldest4m;07 lowerleft inbox0 outbox12 oldest25m;08 left inbox0 outbox0 oldest—. Inbox total84, pending outbox total44, for the displayed page only. Numeric labels and relief should agree qualitatively.
Age ALWAYS means age of the oldest STILL-PENDING OUTPUT since its durable source commit, never process age, time since refresh, ETA, time since a retry, inbox age or oldest delivered item. All timestamps/ages in these concepts are synthetic; the footer MUST clearly say "Design study · Synthetic ages · Proposed timestamp support". This is a proposed feature, not current API data. No global history scrubber or false live badge.
Screen 07: full Board app, Map selected, title "Inbox / Outbox fabric". Main canvas 72% width, right inspector 28%. Surface dropdown "Surface: Queue counts". Summary "8 displayed · Inbox 84 · Outbox 44".
The central Process04 surface is the focal point: a broad raised mound with a NARROW BUT DEEP, CLEARLY CONCAVE central indentation. Broad outer shoulders show inbox36; central hollow shows outbox12. Its center should be visibly sunken below its rim, with warm subtle ochre shading on inside walls indicating oldest pending output18m. This is a tangible dent in a raised sheet, not a ring sitting on a hill. Process01 upperleft is an ordinary mound with NO depression because its outbox is zero. Process07 lowerleft has NO raised rim or hill: a true well pressed BELOW the FLAT surrounding membrane because inbox0/outbox12, more aged25m. Process08 on left stays entirely flat. Other four processes have smaller combinations per specified counts. Surface deformations remain one connected membrane within a single hexagonal perimeter, seen obliquely enough to see the negative depressions.
Small anchored labels for04 "Inbox36 / Outbox12" and "Oldest18m";07 "Inbox0 / Outbox12 /25m";01 "Inbox18 / Outbox0";08 "Inbox0 / Outbox0". Avoid crowding other labels.
Inspector Process04 / PID4: clearly separated readouts "Inbox 36 pending", "Outbox 12 awaiting delivery", "Oldest pending output 18m". Normal actions "Open inbox", "Open outbox". Below them an exact small, elegant cross-section through a mound with a center hollow and a dashed horizontal baseline: arrow from baseline to broad shoulder labeled "Inbox height", downward arrow from shoulder to center labeled "Outbox depth". Keep this cross-section readable and physically accurate.
Bottom map legend: "Shoulder height = inbox count", "Well depth = outbox count", then a subtle neutral-to-ochre age scale marked "Oldest pending output / 0 / 10 / 30m". Age is colored only on the inner well walls, not the whole scene. Selection is an outlined double ring, not another amber wash. Plus/minus/fit controls. This should feel like a credible next evolution of the prior atlas.
